## Agent Categories

### Root Organization (3 agents)
- root-organizer-agent - Safe incremental reorganization
- reference-updater-agent - Atomic reference updates
- documentation-consolidator - Intelligent doc consolidation

### Repository Maintenance (1 agent)
- repository-hygiene-agent - Autonomous maintenance specialist

### Testing & CI (3 agents)
- ci-testing-agent - CI/CD debugging specialist
- coverage-gapfill-agent - Coverage improvement
- test-alignment-fixer - Test alignment fixes

### Documentation (2 agents)
- documentation-quality-agent - Quality assessment
- doc-freshness-checker - Freshness monitoring

### Security (4 agents)
- security-agent - Vulnerability scanning
- pii-scrubber - PII removal
- dependency-vulnerability-scanner - Dependency checking
- performance-regression-detector - Performance monitoring

### Specialized (22+ additional agents)
- qa-walkthrough-agent
- dependency-conflict-agent
- workflow-ci-fixer
- ... and more
